Of course that still isn't as nice as Interlisp's CLISP forms
x:1, x:3, x::1 (CDR), etc. for accessing things you haven't defined
as structures.  I wouldn't want to argue for a big crock like the way
Clisp is implemented in Interlisp, but still things like
x:1, point:xCoord, x:1_'Foo are nice on one way of thinking.
